title: Knowledge Graph + Master Machinist + CourseBuilder Integration

units.title: Knowledge graph from auto-categorized tips
units.details: Added 'tribal_tip' to NodeType and 'relates_to' to EdgeType in KnowledgeGraphEngine. Created tribal_graph action for seeding graph with auto-categorized tips. Added seedTribalTips() and queryTribalGraph() functions.

units.title: Master Machinist recommendation mode
units.details: Added masterMachinistRecommend() method that returns top 3 tips with 'Senior machinists say:' prefix, provenance chain (captured_by, times_applied, success_rate), and relevance scoring (confidence + usage + evidence).

units.title: CourseBuilder + Academy integration
units.details: Added domain-aware grouping to courseBuild() with groupBy parameter ('category', 'domain', 'domain_category'). Added preferDomain parameter to sort cam_software domain tips first for CAM courses. Added DOMAIN_LABELS mapping. ApprenticeEngine bridge to tribalKnowledgeEngine.ingest() confirmed functional.
